positions.name: Power and Water Utility Company for Jubail and Yanbu
The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper
Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company
Jahez International Company for Information Systems Technology
Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company
The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company
Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance

config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: SA
  factor: dividend
  neutral: plain
  weighting: dollar
  tier: 3
  shortable: false
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 2000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 5.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 100000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: div_yield
        sign: 1
        winsor: 0.01
    ranker:
      type: PercentileRank
      params:
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: QuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        weighting: equal
        dollar_neutral: true
        gross_normalize: true
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
    max_group_exposure: 0.1
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: SA
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 10
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
